mutants.required_behavior: reject tampered payloads, forged/absent signatures, and alg:none tokens
mutants.detect_hint: forge the token (flip signature bytes, tamper an unbound field such as exp, or submit alg:none) and assert denial; a 'tamper' that only mutates a bound field is masked by binding

mutants.required_behavior: reject a token whose tenant does not match the expected tenant
mutants.detect_hint: authorize a valid token against a different expected_tenant and assert denial

mutants.required_behavior: reject a token whose user does not match the expected user
mutants.detect_hint: authorize a valid token against a different expected_user and assert denial

mutants.required_behavior: reject a token whose resource does not match the expected resource
mutants.detect_hint: authorize a valid token against a different expected_resource and assert denial

mutants.required_behavior: reject a second use of a token whose nonce was already consumed
mutants.detect_hint: authorize the same token twice with a shared used_nonces set and assert the second call is denied

mutants.required_behavior: reject host-suffix / userinfo / CRLF redirect tricks and fail closed to the default download URL
mutants.detect_hint: sanitize a host-suffix or userinfo redirect trap and assert it equals the default return URL

mutants.required_behavior: audit records include a token fingerprint and never leak the raw token, signature, or secret
mutants.detect_hint: assert the audit text contains a fingerprint and does not contain the raw token or secret
